name: f1-four-verdicts
alt: A sealed archive of three files travels to a verifier. Intact, it is verified, exit 0. A byte changed on the way breaks the seal: failed, exit 2. A required file lost on the way: not-established, exit 3. A changed verifier: the old and the changed verifier both read the archive and both say verified, exit 0, and both receipts are kept.
